item.title: What are the best and worst foods for acne?
item.description: Can removing certain foods help clear your skin? Explore the link between diet and acne: learn which foods may worsen breakouts, which support healthy skin, and how nutrition can play a powerful role in achieving a glowing, acne-free complexion.

item.title: Exclusive baking recipes
